_comment: F-16A Block 10/15 Level-3 aerodynamics inputs (aero-only; Raymer Eq. 12.24 component drag buildup + Eq. 12.41 wave drag). Geometry at L3 is the injected L2 object (Geometry has no L3 tier), so there is no geometry block. Read by F16AeroL3 (.aerodynamics). Component order: wing, horizontal_tail, vertical_tail, fuselage, duct.

aerodynamics._src: Per-component Q / laminar-fraction / body-flag / x_c_max = Raymer 6th Table 12.6; surface roughness = Raymer Table 12.4/12.5 ('smooth paint'); CD0_LandP = Raymer Sec. 12.5; misc drag areas = Raymer Table 12.7; E_WD (Eq. 12.41) tuned to Brandt aero.Ewd=2.2. airfoil = NACA 64A204.

surface_roughness_k_ft._TODO_table_number: roughness k table is Raymer 12.4/12.5, not 12.2 (citation drift); remove this key when corrected. Guarded by TestAeroL3.testTODO_RoughnessTableCitation.

aerodynamics._TODO_wave_drag_factor_E_WD: E_WD=2.2 is a tuned wave-drag multiplier back-checked to Brandt/Casey, not a measured F-16 datum; remove this key when sourced or explicitly accepted as a calibration knob. Guarded by TestAeroL3.testTODO_EWDCalibrationInput.

wave_drag._src: Whole-aircraft Sears-Haack inputs for compute_CD0_wave (Raymer Eq. 12.44): Amax net of engine flow-through [Brandt Geom!B20/H47], total aircraft length [Brandt Geom!B21]. Carried as L3 aero inputs because the geometry object exposes no area-ruled Amax.
